source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Plan top edge = North, bottom edge = South, left = West, right = East (unchanged from seed, confirmed by South elevation door/window layout matching plan south wall).
Wall thickness ~0.24m per plan annotations; modeled as zero-thickness representative planes at wall centerlines.
Ground floor (F1) height 3.0m, first floor (F2) height 3.6m, total 6.6m, per East/West elevation vertical dimension breakdown.
F1 south wall has exactly ONE exterior door (D_R1S_ext2, x=0.54-1.44m, z=0-2.1m); all other south wall gaps at that row are windows.

F2 office-to-corridor doors (Off1-4) are positioned adjacent to their shared partition walls (offset by the 360mm partition half-thickness), not centered in the room, per pixel measurement of 2f_view.png door arcs against the calibrated 15000mm dimension chain; corrected from an earlier centered-door assumption.
F2 ConfA/ConfB doors to corridor are symmetric about the central partition at x=7.5, each ~0.6m wide, per visible arc geometry; not independently re-measured this pass.
F1 room-to-corridor doors (R1N-R3N, R1S-R3S) are adjacent to their partitions, consistent with the same 360/900mm module; retained from seed pixel-based placement.
Interior door widths generally ~0.9m except ConfA/B (~0.6m each) and the F1 west corridor entrance and south exterior door, per elevation glazing widths.
Door heights: 2.1m for interior doors and D_R1S_ext2; 2.4m for the West corridor entrance glazed door on F1.
unresolved: F2 ConfA/ConfB corridor door split exact widths not independently pixel-verified this pass (visually near-symmetric ~0.6m each side of x=7.5).
Door swing direction/leaf count not modeled, only presence and connectivity.
Room role labels are descriptive based on furniture, not authoritative source naming.
North/East/West facade window placements and F1 interior partition door exact widths retain prior seed pixel-based values, not re-verified in this pass.
This pass focused on F2 office-to-corridor door positions found to be mis-centered; other geometry retained from seed.
